    AI Overview
    Justin Rose has won one major championship in his career, the 2013 U.S. Open at Merion Golf Club. As of April 2026, this remains his sole major title, although he has achieved significant success with a 2016 Olympic Gold Medal, a 2018 FedEx Cup title, and multiple runner-up finishes in other majors. 
    Key Major and Notable Wins: 
    • 2013 U.S. Open: Won by two strokes over Phil Mickelson and Jason Day.
    • 2016 Olympic Games: Won Gold in Rio de Janeiro, marking golf's return to the Olympics.
    • 2018 FedEx Cup Champion: Won the season-long PGA Tour competition. 
    Major Championship Runner-Up Finishes: 
    • Masters Tournament: T2 in 2015, 2017, and a playoff loss in 2025.
    • The Open Championship: Runner-up in 2018 and 2024. 
    Rose is a former world number one and has secured over 20 professional wins across the PGA and European Tours.

    AI Overview
    Yes, Justin Rose has won one major championship in his career, the 2013 U.S. Open at Merion Golf Club. He was the first Englishman to win the U.S. Open since 1970. In addition to his major title, he is the 2016 Olympic gold medalist and has multiple runner-up finishes at the Masters and The Open Championship. 
    Key Major and Notable Achievements: 
    • 2013 U.S. Open: Champion
    • Masters Tournament: Runner-up (2017, 2025)
    • The Open Championship: Runner-up (2018, 2024)
    • Olympics: Gold Medalist (2016)
    • PGA Tour Wins: 13+ victories (including 2024 AT&T National Pro-Am)
